description: An AirPods charging case sits on a green-covered surface, with a white charging cable lying in front of it. The left hand reaches in from the left to grasp and lift the case while the right hand brings the cable end toward the case; the right hand aligns the connector and pushes it into the port as the left hand steadies and slightly rotates the case, making the case a left-hand object and the cable a right-hand object.
